resources.string: Disabling background sync helps save a bit of memory and keeps things lighter, but it also means Yagni Launcher won’t automatically update your apps, widgets, or shortcuts.\n\nYour app drawer might show outdated icons, missing widgets, or shortcuts that no longer work.
Prevent other grid items from moving
Enable or disable grid item animation
Clean up unused icons and previews

App icons (original and themed), custom icons, icon packs, widget previews, and shortcut icons are cached locally for faster loading. Clean up checks these files against your launcher data and removes only unused ones, such as icons from uninstalled apps, removed custom icons, deleted icon packs, or unused icon variants. Files currently in use are kept.
Clean unused cache automatically on launch
